scene: The brass orrery whirs softly, spinning tiny jeweled planets before you.
picture: A flat side view along a level tiled observatory floor beneath glowing constellations. On the far left, a mechanical brass orrery clicks softly, displaying a silver crank at its base. Next to it, the girl in her teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair reaching out toward a central ruby orb. On the far right stands a glowing turquoise console.
shown: a notched silver crank sticking out on the far left of the orrery base
a glowing ruby sphere spinning slowly in the centre of the brass rings
a tall glowing terminal humming with turquoise lights on the far right

variants.scene: Golden gears click as brass orbits dance beneath the painted starry dome.
The mechanical universe clicks smoothly while you wonder where {quest} might be hidden.
Polished rings spin gently, carrying miniature worlds past the quiet observatory windows.
